customers_say: Customers find the door lock to be a premium product with many features, including fingerprint and passcode entry options, and appreciate its appearance and handy convenience. The installation process is smoothly done, and they like its functionality, though some report issues with the front lock not working and the fingerprint scanner stopping unexpectedly. The connectivity receives mixed feedback, with several customers reporting no wifi connectivity issues.

reviews.body: Service was perfectly done. Installation is perfect. Value product. Sturdy build, looks good too with many options. Thank you.

reviews.author: Kanraj Jain
reviews.title: Good Features, but Fingerprint Sensitivity Needs Improvement
reviews.body: The Qubo Smart Lock offers great functionality overall—keyless entry works seamlessly, and the mobile app integration is smooth. Installation was fairly straightforward, and the build quality feels solid and premium. However, one major drawback I faced was while trying to register fingerprints. It consistently failed to recognize or register my wife’s fingerprint, no matter how many times we tried. reviews.title: Battery Drains Every 2 Weeks – Poor Product Quality & Worse Support
reviews.body: I bought this smart lock for around ₹20,000, expecting reliability and long-term value. Unfortunately, the experience has been extremely disappointing. The unit now drains batteries abnormally fast. I am forced to replace 8 AA batteries every 2 weeks, which is completely unreasonable for a smart lock. My earlier unit used to run for a very long time on the same set of batteries, so this clearly points to a serious product quality issue. reviews.author: Durga Srinivas
reviews.title: Amazing Lock
reviews.body: The Qubo Smart Lock Ultra is an impressive device, offering excellent security features combined with modern technology. Its seamless integration with smartphones makes remote access and monitoring incredibly convenient. The fingerprint and passcode entry options provide versatility, and the auto-locking feature enhances safety. Installation is straightforward, and the lock's sleek design adds a stylish touch to any door. Overall, it's a reliable, smart choice for anyone looking to upgrade home security with ease.
